cause: The triage helper initially assumed a separate fingerprint file for both archives. Mean stores its 783 source fingerprints directly in archive-sha256.json; spatial has a separate 623-entry source-fingerprints.json.
resolution: Read the immutable mean source-entry hashes as its fingerprints, retain the spatial original fingerprint file, and compare every source entry. No existing replay code, archive, hash, tolerance, or test was changed for this correction.
